summary: Tested new invitation analytics (referrer_id on signup, invited_by attribution, /users/{id}/invite-stats, invite_accepted notification) + admin invite-flyer PNG endpoint. 11/11 backend pytest tests passed. Frontend smoke (mobile 390x844): welcome page captured ?ref=<id> into localStorage 'youbelong.invite.ref'; admin maggie saw purple 'Invite flyer' quick-link (testID admin-invite-flyer); /admin/flyer rendered form, Refresh, Download PNG, and a live QR preview; frankie profile showed new 'Invites' tile (testID profile-invites-stat) with numeric count. ShareYouBelong builds personalised URL with ?ref=<user.id>. Non-admin (frankie) on /admin/invite-flyer correctly returned 403. Flyer PNG confirmed at exactly 1240x1754 via PIL.
critical_code_review_comments: Self-referral guard relies on body.referrer_id != newly-minted user.id; since the new id is unguessable client-side, this branch can only ever fire if the client deliberately echoes a fabricated id. Acceptable, but worth noting the guard is largely defensive.

server.py is now 5225 lines — approaching/exceeding the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting auth, admin, games, community routers into separate modules in a future refactor (pre-existing, not new with this change).

Backend logs show benign passlib/bcrypt 'AttributeError: module bcrypt has no attribute __about__' warning at startup — does not affect functionality (passwords still hash/verify) but worth pinning bcrypt<4.1 or upgrading passlib.
seed_data_creation: Created 6 temporary users with prefix 'ref_' during testing; all cleaned up post-run via /tmp/cleanup_ref_users.py (also pruned 4 stale invite_accepted notifications pointing at deleted users).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Invitation analytics + admin invite-flyer features are fully working. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_invite_flyer.py is reusable for regression. To clean up between runs: `python /tmp/cleanup_ref_users.py` or wipe users where username matches ^ref_.
